## Summary
A secant slope is the average rate of change between two points.

## Findings
1. **Definition** — the slope of the line through two points on a curve. [Khan Academy](https://www.khanacademy.org/math/ap-calculus-ab)
2. **Use** — as the two points close in, the secant approaches the tangent. [Paul's Online Notes](https://tutorial.math.lamar.edu/)
